description:
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Gravecrawler.
Gravecrawler dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Skullclamp, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
